pipeline.title: Roche’s GLP-1/GIP drug hits in phase 2 diabetes trial, fueling best-in-disease hopes
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 trial of Roche’s dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist has hit its primary endpoints, painting the drug candidate as a potential treatment for people with Type 2 diabetes and overweight or obesity.

pipeline.title: J&J firms up Caplyta's 1st phase 3 win in bipolar-associated manic episodes
pipeline.summary: As Johnson & Johnson’s $14.6 billion bet on Intra-Cellular Therapies continues to pay off with blockbuster sales of Caplyta, the atypical antipsychotic has passed a phase 3 test that puts it one step closer to a broader psychiatric label.

pipeline.title: Cue chalks up phase 2 hives win for Xolair challenger
pipeline.summary: A midstage study of Cue Biopharma’s hives drug candidate has hit its primary endpoint, emboldening the biotech to move the would-be challenger to Xolair into a phase 2b/3 trial.

pipeline.title: Beacon lights path to FDA approval with pivotal trial win for rare vision loss gene therapy
pipeline.summary: Beacon Therapeutics has found the light in a rare vision loss disease that has left larger companies in the dark. The biotech’s gene therapy for X-linked retinitis pigmentosa (XLRP) successfully improved visual acuity in a pivotal trial, setting up the startup to seek regulatory

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly escalates oral SERD battle with FDA approval for Inluriyo, Verzenio combo
pipeline.summary: With longer progression-free survival, Jake Van Naarden, president of Lilly Oncology, told Fierce he expects most patients to choose the combination over oral SERD monotherapy.

pipeline.title: DPHARM: Where to begin with AI in clinical trials?
pipeline.summary: The promise of AI to transform the clinical trial process is being realized in fits and starts, but early applications of the technology might be surprising.

pipeline.title: Inside the growing world of biopharma prediction markets
pipeline.summary: In this episode of “The Top Line,” we explore the growing space of biopharma prediction markets, how they work and the risks they create around insider information and clinical trial integrity.

pipeline.title: Medtronic earns FDA clearance for LigaSure use with its Hugo robotic system
pipeline.summary: The FDA has cleared Medtronic’s LigaSure RAS Maryland jaw vessel sealer-divider to be used in combination with the device maker’s Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system.

pipeline.title: Xenon pauses phase 3 depression trials after psychosis events
pipeline.summary: The company has voluntarily stopped enrolling new patients in the studies in response to reports of mostly mild or moderate adverse events.

pipeline.title: BMS dumps $100M Orum degrader-antibody conjugate after glimpsing phase 1 data
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has axed the degrader-antibody conjugate it bought from Orum Therapeutics for $100 million, walking away from the asset after seeing phase 1 data.

pipeline.title: FDA approves Ultragenyx’s gene therapy Fayuvi for rare neurodegenerative disorder
pipeline.summary: Ultragenyx scored a belated regulatory win with FDA approval for a first-in-disease gene therapy, giving the company a boost after a previous regulatory rejection and a recent late-stage setback.

pipeline.title: Changing expectations: How GRAM is strengthening CDMO partnerships
pipeline.summary: How proactive risk management, transparency and flexible communication can turn a CDMO relationship into a true strategic partnership.

pipeline.title: Roche’s Lunsumio delivers positive confirmatory trial readout in follicular lymphoma
pipeline.summary: Roche’s T-cell engager portfolio has notched another milestone, as a phase 3 trial of the company’s Lunsumio met its primary endpoint in earlier-line follicular lymphoma.

pipeline.title: Clinical trials reach a new automation inflection point
pipeline.summary: As trial complexity grows, agentic AI is emerging as a new model for connecting workflows and accelerating execution.

pipeline.title: A hidden tradeoff in Trump’s drug pricing deals
pipeline.summary: The government has announced “most-favored-nation” pricing agreements with 26 pharma companies. But the deals could stymie other plans to lower the country’s spending on prescription drugs.

pipeline.title: Iambic maintains momentum from string of Big Pharma partnerships by aiming for IPO
pipeline.summary: Iambic Therapeutics is maintaining the momentum generated by its recent megaround and Big Pharma partnerships by gearing up to go public.

pipeline.title: Organon-commissioned survey finds 1 in 3 UK women feel their migraine pain not taken seriously
pipeline.summary: One in three women in the U.K. feel their migraine pain “is taken less seriously by others because of their gender.”

pipeline.title: Boehringer, Envisagenics sign $1B multi-target oncology collaboration
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim and AI drug discovery company Envisagenics have agreed to a potential $1 billion multi-year pact that will task Boehringer with validating tumor-specific targets.

pipeline.title: Beacon eye gene therapy hits mark in late-stage study
pipeline.summary: Beacon claimed the findings represent the first time a treatment for X-linked retinitis pigmentosa, a rare and potentially blinding condition, met its main goal in a pivotal trial.

pipeline.title: Trump calls for some childhood vaccines be split into smaller doses
pipeline.summary: The president announced plans to split some childhood immunizations in the U.S. into five separate shots, given as “20% doses” every six months. The decision has garnered significant backlash from the medical community.

pipeline.title: Novo talks up drug launches in effort to win back investors
pipeline.summary: At a “capital markets day” in London, executives outlined a roadmap to better compete with key rival Eli Lilly and soon bring forth several multibillion-dollar products.

pipeline.title: New MFN deal details reignite concerns that Trump's pricing policy favors pharma
pipeline.summary: Amid lawmaker and advocacy group efforts to parse the White House’s “most favored nation” drug pricing deals with drugmakers, newly revealed—yet heavily redacted—information is reigniting concerns about just who exactly the Trump administration policy benefits.

pipeline.title: IntraBio's Aqneursa scores expansion, now the first treatment for rare ataxia
pipeline.summary: IntraBio's streak of success in the rare neurological category continues, as the drugmaker racks up a second indication for Aqneursa, now the first treatment in the world indicated for a rare ataxia.

pipeline.title: White House plans to put NIH grants under political control: reports
pipeline.summary: President Donald Trump is attempting to seize further control of funding decisions made by the National Institutes of Health. According to multiple reports, senior officials met in the Oval Office on Friday to discuss plans for an executive order that would create an external pan

pipeline.title: Novo struggles to appease restive investors with consumer plans, blockbuster ambitions
pipeline.summary: With reports leaking out of investor discontent, CEO Mike Doustdar opened Novo's Capital Markets Day by acknowledging that the company’s leadership “have to convince” the audience that “there is a bright future for Novo.”

pipeline.title: Bayer offloads cancer drug Stivarga to Grünenthal for up to $431M as new competition looms
pipeline.summary: Bayer has decided to offload its aging cancer drug Stivarga to German compatriot Grünenthal as a potential new competitor from Exelixis nears an FDA decision.

pipeline.title: China targets 25% share of global first-in-class drugs in new 5-year plan
pipeline.summary: China is aiming to account for at least 25% of first-in-class drugs as part of a five-year push to cement its emerging status as a hotbed for innovative R&D.

pipeline.title: Telix buys ITM in bid to create a ‘radiopharmaceutical powerhouse’
pipeline.summary: Worth $1.65 billion up front, the deal combines two large pipelines and manufacturing networks, helping Telix potentially “corner the industry” for radiopharmaceuticals, one analyst wrote.

pipeline.title: How J&J paved the way for Compass’ coming psychedelic drug launch
pipeline.summary: In an interview with BioPharma Dive, Compass executives said that, should the FDA approve their treatment, they hope to capitalize on a strategy pioneered by J&J in selling the ketamine spray Spravato.

pipeline.title: Analysts ‘extremely bullish’ as Telix beams into Novartis’ territory with $1.6B ITM acquisition
pipeline.summary: Telix has struck a deal to buy ITM Isotope Technologies Munich for $1.65 billion upfront, securing an R&D pipeline led by a rival to Novartis’ Lutathera and a radiopharmaceutical supply network.

pipeline.title: Are healthcare systems really ready for GLP-1s?
pipeline.summary: New GLP-1 therapy indications mean new challenges for pharma companies, from care to consumer trust.

pipeline.title: Behind the outcomes: How whole-patient support is reshaping oncology care
pipeline.summary: As oncology care grows personalized and home-based, support around treatment becomes as vital as treatment.

pipeline.title: Retension and Lilly-backed TRex Bio both set out plans to join biotech IPO stampede
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly-backed TRex Bio and hypertension-focused Retension Pharmaceuticals are the latest biotechs to set out plans to go public this year.

pipeline.title: Artelo’s ex-AstraZeneca cannabinoid agonist holds its own against GLP-1 drug semaglutide in obese mice
pipeline.summary: Artelo Biosciences’ oral dual cannabinoid agonist showed weight loss comparable to the GLP-1 semaglutide in obese mice.

pipeline.title: With pioneering ADHD data, Alkermes eyes orexin agonist as potential ‘company changer’
pipeline.summary: Following Takeda’s historic approval of the first orexin agonist with its narcolepsy treatment Orzeyful, Alkermes has followed up with pioneering data that looks to take the hyped drug class out of sleep disorders and into broader patient populations.

pipeline.title: Xenon shares fall following depression trial pause
pipeline.summary: The occurrence of “neuropsychiatric” adverse events in testing fueled investor doubts about a drug the FDA is already reviewing for a form of epilepsy.

pipeline.title: Refreshed Novo corrals 3 new early-stage obesity drugs from Kallyope
pipeline.summary: New-look Novo is digging deeper into its metabolic roots with three new obesity programs purchased from New York biotech Kallyope.

pipeline.title: Panthers and zebras and meerkats, oh my: A peek behind the curtain at Fierce Pharma Week 2026
pipeline.summary: With many of the healthcare industry’s top marketing minds converging in the City of Brotherly Love this past week, the galvanizing power of humor, authenticity and a little outside-of-the-box thinking in an ever-changing consumer landscape was again at the forefront of Fierce Ph

pipeline.title: This week in charts: GSK’s China deals, the $300M IPO club and selling the news
pipeline.summary: The latest installment in BioPharma Dive’s new visualization-focused series features a stock sell-off that confused Wall Street analysts and a closer look at an industry-leading partnership streak.

pipeline.title: Europe's CHMP endorses slew of new medicines, including new offerings from Novo and AZ
pipeline.summary: The CHMP recommendation for Novo's next gen hemophilia A treatment was one of several noteworthy endorsements made by the EU agency this week.

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx prices Sanfilippo gene therapy at $4M; Bristol Myers shelves Orum drug
pipeline.summary: Ultragenyx’s second gene therapy approval since August gives it another sellable voucher. Elsewhere, Roche declared success in a blood cancer trial and a cell therapy maker is cutting costs.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—China deals safe from COINS?; Key WCLC data; Legend’s new CEO
pipeline.summary: Most drug licensing deals with China will be safe from rules being drafted by the U.S. Treasury Department, Reuters reports. Akeso and Summit's ivonescimab, B7-H3 ADCs and a surprise negative overall survival trend from Enhertu headlined WCLC26. Plus more.

pipeline.title: FDA clears Aptitude’s latest Metrix molecular dx to test for COVID
pipeline.summary: The FDA granted Aptitude its first 510(k) clearance for the next-generation Metrix COVID diagnostic that features three-times greater sensitivity with 30% faster results that its original emergency use authorized test.

pipeline.title: Inflammation biotech Electra charges up with $350M from upsized IPO
pipeline.summary: Electra Therapeutics is the latest biotech to overshoot its own IPO expectations this year, with the inflammation-focused company bringing in $350 million from this morning’s Nasdaq listing.

pipeline.title: ARPA-H launches SPECTRA program, new autism research initiative
pipeline.summary: Researchers will create an end-to-end system to identify ASD risk factors, connect patients to appropriate interventions and accelerate clinical research for new therapies.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Legend poaches Novartis vet to boost commercial potential
pipeline.summary: After former Legend Biotech CEO Ying Huang, Ph.D., left the company suddenly in July, Legend has found its permanent CEO, poaching Novartis veteran Ingrid Zhang as the CAR-T specialist eyes its next phase of growth.

pipeline.title: Bayer’s Kerendia secures FDA nod as first drug in 30 years for Type 1 diabetes-associated kidney disease
pipeline.summary: The heart and kidney med earned the first FDA nod in three decades for adults with chronic kidney disease associated with type 1 diabetes.

pipeline.title: Goa Therapeutics launches with ‘immeasurably huge’ vision of creating Narcan for alcohol
pipeline.summary: A new biotech has sprung out of stealth with a bold vision to develop the “greatest therapeutic of all time”—a drug that can quickly sober up people who have had too much to drink.

pipeline.title: Bavarian Nordic secures Sanofi, AZ vet to fill shoes of longtime CEO Paul Chaplin
pipeline.summary: Following the news that longtime helmsman Paul Chaplin would be hanging up his hat at Bavarian Nordic earlier this year, the Danish vaccine maker has found a CEO replacement whose CV spans leadership roles across Sanofi, AstraZeneca and Pfizer.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly dishes out fresh produce to cultivate Alzheimer’s awareness
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly is marking World Alzheimer’s Day with a partnership to distribute 13,500 boxes of brain-healthy fresh produce and educational materials to underserved senior populations across the U.S.

pipeline.title: Sun Pharma shines a light on alopecia areata in ‘Regrowth Restyled’ campaign
pipeline.summary: Sun Pharma is teaming up with fashion designer Christian Siriano for a new educational campaign focused on the positives of regrowing lost hair.

pipeline.title: ‘People like the sincerity of it’: comedian Damon Wayans on humor, relatability and DME awareness in Genentech campaign
pipeline.summary: The comedian sat down with Fierce to discuss his health advocacy journey as a type 2 diabetic and his work using comedy and humor to bring light to sight-related diabetes complications in Genentech's "All Eyes on DME."

pipeline.title: FDA drops warning letter on Bausch & Lomb, citing contamination concerns
pipeline.summary: The FDA issued a warning letter to Bausch & Lomb over contamination concerns at its Tampa, Florida, facility that produces prescription and over-the-counter eye medications.

pipeline.title: 'Still a bull': Novo's CEO on honoring heritage and planning for the future amid corporate rebrand
pipeline.summary: Novo CEO Mike Doustdar—tapped to breathe new life into the Danish drugmaker last year after losing GLP-1 marketing ground to chief rival Eli Lilly—isn’t one to make changes for the sake of change.

pipeline.title: How Learning Systems Move Pharma Marketing Beyond the Box Score
pipeline.summary: It’s time for pharma marketers to up their ask of AI—not just making better decisions, but building smarter systems that learn from every outcome.

pipeline.title: Beyond clinical endpoints: Rethinking ALS drug development through disease biology
pipeline.summary: After decades of hard-won progress, ALS drug development is entering a new era, building on established efficacy measures like survival and ALSFRS-R with biology-driven science that captures the full heterogeneity of the disease.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Holiday takes toll on prescriptions
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Novo reveals 4k more employees were laid off; Sionna halves staff
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: All 50 states apply to participate in new Medicaid drug pricing model, White House says
pipeline.summary: The Trump administration is rolling out a new model that aims to bring most-favored nation pricing to the Medicaid space.
